Class LazyWheel

java.lang.Object
Wheel
LazyWheel
public class LazyWheel extends Wheel
A wheel that only responds to every other spin request. It starts awake: the first spin advances it, the second one is ignored (it "falls asleep"), the third one advances it again, and so on.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elián Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

      public void spin(int direction)
      Spins this wheel only if it is awake, then toggles its state. Every call toggles the state, whether or not the wheel moved.
      Overrides:
      spin in class Wheel
      Parameters:
